      betType - the new BetType to assign

      public void checkIfPlayerRaised(Player activePlayer)

      public boolean testAllPlayersFolded(Player activePlayer)
      Tests whether all players other than the active player have folded.

    • endBetting

      public boolean endBetting(Player activePlayer)
      Evaluates whether the current state of the betting round satisfies any end condition and, if so, sets the appropriate bet type to conclude the round.
      Parameters:
      activePlayer - the Player who last acted; used to exclude RAISE actions from triggering end
      Returns:
      true if betting should stop, false if it should continue

    • checkBetType

      public void checkBetType()
      Drives one full betting pass through the turn order (called from the round-status handler). After betting finishes, handles ENDROUND and SKIP2SHOWDOWN transitions.

    • removeForfeited

      public void removeForfeited()
      Removes all players whose action is FORFEIT from the round's player list and updates the internal player count and turn order.

      Signals the round to stop as quickly as possible (e.g. when the game window is closed). Sets all undecided players to FOLD and clears all active-turn flags.
